name: Sanjay Dutt
bio: Sanjay Dutt (born 29 July 1959) is an Indian film actor and producer who works in Hindi cinema in addition to a few Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, and Punjabi films. Dutt is the son of Hindi film stars Sunil and Nargis Dutt. He made his debut in 1981. Known for his versatile roles, style and intensity, he has often portrayed flawed heroes on screen.
